name: Set Dataset
description: Replaces the entire value of a dataset. Used to seed dropdown option lists, push snackbar/dialog state (via the fixed dataset names 'snackinfo' and 'dialoginfo'), and set simple flags.

data.description: Full replacement value: object, array, string, etc.

wellKnownDatasets.snackinfo: Triggers a snackbar. data shape: { open: true, type: 'error'|'success'|..., message: '...' }. There is no separate 'showsnackbar' exec — this is how snackbars are actually shown.
wellKnownDatasets.dialoginfo: Triggers a confirm dialog. data shape: { open: true, title, description, btn1: { chld: 'YES', props: { whenclick: [...] } }, btn2: { chld: 'NO', props: { whenclick: [] } } }.
